title: Proposal-only coordinate derivation bound to proposal identity
objective: Establish the third narrow COTRA-P10 vision grain on top of the closed SG-000034 visual proposal registry, the closed SG-000033 window-scoped capture registry, the closed COTRA-P09 structured-UIA registry, the SG-000018 replay-resistant foundation, SG-000019 class enforcement, SG-000020 trust and revoke records, and the closed COTRA-P08 registry: a single approved proposal-only coordinate derivation shape bound to one server-allocated typed proposal identity with arguments proposal_id and expected_proposal_generation only, with server-derived frame-relative coordinates computed deterministically from the exact bounded proposal region, server-allocated typed coordinate identity with derivation generation, workspace, and policy revision binding, fresh SOFT approval digest binding, immediate pre-derivation stale-proposal revalidation, protected Cotra surface exclusion, bounded derivation payload, and explicit denial of every input execution, input lease, raw coordinate request, monitor and desktop scope, clipboard, network, and elevation shape.

authority_delta.filesystem: No new filesystem authority. Derivation reads bounded proposal and frame metadata already held by the SG-000034 and SG-000033 registries and performs no file read or write; retention of derivations outside bounded evidence is denied.
authority_delta.process: No new process launch, injection, or termination authority. The existing read-only process identity is reused for binding only, and the existing SG-000010 whoami-only spawn boundary is unchanged.
authority_delta.network: None. Coordinate derivation is strictly local with no egress, and no fetch, socket, or tunnel authority is added.
authority_delta.browser: None. The closed P08 structured-browser registry is unchanged, and no browser launch, attachment, navigation, download, or upload authority is added.
authority_delta.ui_input: One narrow proposal-only derivation shape is newly added: uia.coordinates/propose deriving evidence coordinates from one exact bound proposal region. No input execution, no input lease, no pointer, no keyboard, no synthetic-input, no raw coordinate request, no monitor scope, no desktop scope, and no other UIA pattern authority is added, and derivation never calls any input API.
authority_delta.secrets: No password, credential, Windows Hello, cookie, token, or session material enters prompts, records, history, logs, MCP responses, snapshots, or evidence packets. Protected Cotra surfaces are never derivation targets, and derivation-adjacent metadata is redacted where it could leak protected material.
authority_delta.approval: One fresh per-action SOFT approval is required for uia.coordinates/propose with exact digest binding over the complete derivation binding set, one-shot consumption, nonce, and expiry. No persistent reuse, no remote delegation, and no caller-supplied approval boolean is introduced.
authority_delta.privileged: None. No elevation, UAC bypass, service installation, privileged desktop access, or secure desktop input is added.

acceptance.claim: Tests prove derivations bind server-derived proposal identity with proposal generation, owning frame, capture generation, owning window, owning process, bounded region, workspace, and policy revision, and that forged proposals, PID reuse, stale processes, restarted processes, and wrong executable identity fail closed before approval.

Tests prove every derivation deterministically computes frame-relative coordinates from the exact bounded proposal region and mints a server-allocated typed coordinate identity bound to the owning proposal, derivation generation, coordinates, workspace, and policy revision, and that replayed, foreign, generation-drifted, and policy-drifted identities fail closed as stale.

Tests prove callers supply no coordinates of any kind, and that caller-supplied coordinates, caller-selected regions, raw coordinate requests, monitor scope, desktop scope, and protected Cotra surfaces are denied with no silent widening.

Tests prove every derivation requires fresh SOFT approval with exact digest binding over workspace, policy revision, proposal, proposal generation, frame, capture generation, owning window, window generation, derived coordinates, and action material, and that missing, stale, reused, and digest-mismatched approvals fail closed with no caller-supplied approval boolean accepted.

Tests prove immediate pre-derivation revalidation denies proposal drift, frame drift, window drift, process drift, generation drift, protected-surface drift, workspace drift, and policy-revision drift without silent retargeting and without input-execution, clipboard, network, or elevation fallback.

Tests prove caller-supplied coordinate ids, coordinate fields, region fields, approval material, secret fields, and widening fields are rejected as malformed or denied, and that input execution, lease grant, clipboard, network, spawn, inject, terminate, and elevation shapes remain denied outside their closed scopes.

Tests prove the agent cannot satisfy derivations through MCP tools, child processes, approval forgery, trust forgery, or replayed prior approvals, and cannot turn a coordinate identity into input authority.
Tests prove replay, expiry, digest mismatch, revision drift, trust-revision drift, and double-consumption protections remain enforced for both approval classes.

Tests prove all closed SG-000034 proposal regressions, all closed SG-000033 capture regressions, all closed P09 structured-UIA regressions, P06 approval flows, SG-000018 through SG-000020 regressions, and the closed P08 registry behavior still pass with digests unchanged outside derivation labeling.

Tests prove personal-profile-style widening, arbitrary DevTools or CDP, browser scripting, credential stores, clipboard access, input execution beyond the closed derivation shape, and network egress remain unreachable through coordinate derivation.

Windows-specific qualification proves structured derivation binding against real Windows process identity where required without fabricating interactive desktop evidence, and headless derivation limits are recorded honestly with unavailable-path fail-closed.

Exact-head Windows and Ubuntu Rust, Node, Governance, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, exact-diff security review, manual review of excluded security-sensitive files, and zero unresolved blocking review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.p10_vision: Bounded input execution with input leases and human interruption remain successor work and must build on coordinate identity without weakening STRONG enforcement, one-shot, expiry, or digest binding.
successor_requirements.p10_exit: COTRA-P10 exits when provider ceiling is enforced, protected surfaces are denied, stale-frame tests pass, and no silent fallback from structured denial into coordinates exists, which SG-000033 capture, SG-000034 proposals, SG-000035 coordinates, plus input-lease and interruption successors must jointly satisfy.
successor_requirements.p11_boundary: Clipboard and network authority remain P11 work and are not granted by coordinate derivation.
